title: Episode 01 Production Scene System

STOP_WORK.priority: hazard evidence, stop decision, restart gate

DAY_RESULT.priority: memory, people change, carry-over; no scorecard

rules: UI must not cover the field merely to explain it.
Choices become visually dominant only at authored decision moments.
Mobile portrait keeps the safe bottom interaction sheet.
Compact landscape keeps the safe right-side interaction dock.
Scene family changes presentation only and cannot change Phase B narrative topology.
Final art replacement uses stable asset slots and does not require event rewrites.
